posts.description: It is sad to observe when a basic human need is put on a pedestal only because it is socially programmed to seem scarce, with so many hurdles in the way of fulfilling that basic desire. posts.title: On Strictly Living outside of your mind
posts.description: Naval Ravikant says that a major source of depression is inward-looking behaviour and I cannot agree more. The more we look inwards and attach every happening with something being wrong with ourself, the more depressed we get. We are constantly in debate with ourselves about ourselves and thus judging, passing comments and comparing ourselves to others. We are constantly finding flaws in ourselves

posts.title: On Listening
posts.description: I love to listen. I like to talk a lot too. I have opinions about everything but I love to listen. It first came as a need and then as a gift that I give to others now. I wanted to be a person that people like and the thing that topped the list in every self-help video, book or an article was to listen. I worked on the skill for years. Along the way, I realised how much people want to to be heard.
